translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.91:1: By the sun and its brightness
verses.91:2: and the moon as it follows it
verses.91:3: and the day as it unveils it
verses.91:4: and the night as it conceals it
verses.91:5: And by heaven and ˹the One˺ Who built it
verses.91:6: and the earth and ˹the One˺ Who spread it
verses.91:7: And by the soul and ˹the One˺ Who fashioned it
verses.91:8: then with ˹the knowledge of˺ right and wrong inspired it
verses.91:9: Successful indeed is the one who purifies their soul
verses.91:10: and doomed is the one who corrupts it
verses.91:11: Thamûd rejected ˹the truth˺ out of arrogance
verses.91:12: when the most wicked of them was roused ˹to kill the she-camel˺
verses.91:13: But the messenger of Allah warned them, “˹Do not disturb˺ Allah’s camel and her ˹turn to˺ drink!”
verses.91:14: Still they defied him and slaughtered her. So their Lord crushed them for their crime, levelling all to the ground
verses.91:15: He has no fear of consequences
